method: scripts/check_chat_jobs.py: one `ask` per job, in English, through the native preview CLI on its own temporary synthetic workbook, run once. Each CLI request loads the model and unloads it on exit, so wallSeconds includes a model start; modelSeconds is the engine time of the decisions alone. The CLI has no window, so it cannot ask a structured question or open a view. Class totals use each job's first run.
